CapacitorUpdater._comment: OTA live web-bundle updates (no store review). autoUpdate downloads DELTA bundles (only changed files) in the background and applies on next open; periodCheckDelay checks every 10 min; the client also checks on app-resume and gates downloads to wifi (see otaUpdate.js). Inert until '@capgo/capacitor-updater' is installed and a channel is set via the Capgo CLI. See MOBILE-OTA-LIVE-UPDATES.md.
